crossRefs.note: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we…
neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that…
not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

translations.web: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
translations.bsb: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have ministered to my own needs and those of my companions.
translations.kjv: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
translations.asv: Ye yourselves know that these hands ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
